# KeyWait

<div align="center">

[Command Index](Command-Index) · [BlitzBasic](BlitzBasic) · [Keyboard](BlitzBasic-Keyboard)

</div>


## Command Syntax

```blitzbasic
KeyWait:Int32
```

## Parameters

**Returns:** The character code of the key that was typed.

## Description

The BlitzPlus name for [WaitKey](WaitKey). It behaves exactly the same.

## Examples

```blitzbasic
Graphics 320, 240, 0, 2
SetBuffer BackBuffer()
Text 10, 10, "Press any character key"
Flip
KeyWait()
```

[GetKey](GetKey), [KeyDown](KeyDown), [KeyHit](KeyHit), [WaitKey](WaitKey)
